**2208 Ekkocardiografi** is a specific procedure code registered in the Danish Health Insurance Register ([[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]]) [^src1]. It is used to identify and track [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] (echocardiography) examinations within the Danish healthcare system [^src2]. Specifically, this code plays a critical role in the national clinical quality measurement efforts for patients with atrial fibrillation, helping to standardize data collection and evaluate the quality of diagnostics and follow-up care across regions [^src1].

The [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] utilizes a broader set of echocardiography codes to capture various types of heart ultrasound procedures. Alongside 2208, the register includes codes such as [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1]. These codes collectively support the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) in monitoring clinical indicators, such as wait times for examinations and the overall diagnostic workflow for cardiovascular diseases.
